function runEuclideanAlgorithm(field, a, b, R) {
    var _a;
    // Assume a's degree is >= b's
    if (a.degree() < b.degree()) {
        _a = [b, a], a = _a[0], b = _a[1];
    }
    var rLast = a;
    var r = b;
    var tLast = field.zero;
    var t = field.one;
    // Run Euclidean algorithm until r's degree is less than R/2
    while (r.degree() >= R / 2) {
        var rLastLast = rLast;
        var tLastLast = tLast;
        rLast = r;
        tLast = t;
        // Divide rLastLast by rLast, with quotient in q and remainder in r
        if (rLast.isZero()) {
            // Euclidean algorithm already terminated?
            return null;
        }
        r = rLastLast;
        var q = field.zero;
        var denominatorLeadingTerm = rLast.getCoefficient(rLast.degree());
        var dltInverse = field.inverse(denominatorLeadingTerm);
        while (r.degree() >= rLast.degree() && !r.isZero()) {
            var degreeDiff = r.degree() - rLast.degree();
            var scale = field.multiply(r.getCoefficient(r.degree()), dltInverse);
            q = q.addOrSubtract(field.buildMonomial(degreeDiff, scale));
            r = r.addOrSubtract(rLast.multiplyByMonomial(degreeDiff, scale));
        }
        t = q.multiplyPoly(tLast).addOrSubtract(tLastLast);
        if (r.degree() >= rLast.degree()) {
            return null;
        }
    }
    var sigmaTildeAtZero = t.getCoefficient(0);
    if (sigmaTildeAtZero === 0) {
        return null;
    }
    var inverse = field.inverse(sigmaTildeAtZero);
    return [t.multiply(inverse), r.multiply(inverse)];
}
function findErrorLocations(field, errorLocator) {
    // This is a direct application of Chien's search
    var numErrors = errorLocator.degree();
    if (numErrors === 1) {
        return [errorLocator.getCoefficient(1)];
    }
    var result = new Array(numErrors);
    var errorCount = 0;
    for (var i = 1; i < field.size && errorCount < numErrors; i++) {
        if (errorLocator.evaluateAt(i) === 0) {
            result[errorCount] = field.inverse(i);
            errorCount++;
        }
    }
    if (errorCount !== numErrors) {
        return null;
    }
    return result;
}
function findErrorMagnitudes(field, errorEvaluator, errorLocations) {
    // This is directly applying Forney's Formula
    var s = errorLocations.length;
    var result = new Array(s);
    for (var i = 0; i < s; i++) {
        var xiInverse = field.inverse(errorLocations[i]);
        var denominator = 1;
        for (var j = 0; j < s; j++) {
            if (i !== j) {
                denominator = field.multiply(denominator, GenericGF_1.addOrSubtractGF(1, field.multiply(errorLocations[j], xiInverse)));

        result[i] = field.multiply(errorEvaluator.evaluateAt(xiInverse), field.inverse(denominator));
        if (field.generatorBase !== 0) {
            result[i] = field.multiply(result[i], xiInverse);
        }
    }
    return result;
}

            error = true;

var BitMatrix_1 = __webpack_require__(0);
function squareToQuadrilateral(p1, p2, p3, p4) {
    var dx3 = p1.x - p2.x + p3.x - p4.x;
    var dy3 = p1.y - p2.y + p3.y - p4.y;
    if (dx3 === 0 && dy3 === 0) { // Affine
        return {
            a11: p2.x - p1.x,
            a12: p2.y - p1.y,
            a13: 0,
            a21: p3.x - p2.x,
            a22: p3.y - p2.y,
            a23: 0,
            a31: p1.x,
            a32: p1.y,
            a33: 1,
        };
    }
    else {
        var dx1 = p2.x - p3.x;
        var dx2 = p4.x - p3.x;
        var dy1 = p2.y - p3.y;
        var dy2 = p4.y - p3.y;
        var denominator = dx1 * dy2 - dx2 * dy1;
        var a13 = (dx3 * dy2 - dx2 * dy3) / denominator;
        var a23 = (dx1 * dy3 - dx3 * dy1) / denominator;
        return {
            a11: p2.x - p1.x + a13 * p2.x,
            a12: p2.y - p1.y + a13 * p2.y,
            a13: a13,
            a21: p4.x - p1.x + a23 * p4.x,
            a22: p4.y - p1.y + a23 * p4.y,
            a23: a23,
            a31: p1.x,
            a32: p1.y,
            a33: 1,
        };
    }
}
function quadrilateralToSquare(p1, p2, p3, p4) {
    // Here, the adjoint serves as the inverse:
    var sToQ = squareToQuadrilateral(p1, p2, p3, p4);
    return {
        a11: sToQ.a22 * sToQ.a33 - sToQ.a23 * sToQ.a32,
        a12: sToQ.a13 * sToQ.a32 - sToQ.a12 * sToQ.a33,
        a13: sToQ.a12 * sToQ.a23 - sToQ.a13 * sToQ.a22,
        a21: sToQ.a23 * sToQ.a31 - sToQ.a21 * sToQ.a33,
        a22: sToQ.a11 * sToQ.a33 - sToQ.a13 * sToQ.a31,
        a23: sToQ.a13 * sToQ.a21 - sToQ.a11 * sToQ.a23,
        a31: sToQ.a21 * sToQ.a32 - sToQ.a22 * sToQ.a31,
        a32: sToQ.a12 * sToQ.a31 - sToQ.a11 * sToQ.a32,
        a33: sToQ.a11 * sToQ.a22 - sToQ.a12 * sToQ.a21,
    };
}
function times(a, b) {
    return {
        a11: a.a11 * b.a11 + a.a21 * b.a12 + a.a31 * b.a13,
        a12: a.a12 * b.a11 + a.a22 * b.a12 + a.a32 * b.a13,
        a13: a.a13 * b.a11 + a.a23 * b.a12 + a.a33 * b.a13,
        a21: a.a11 * b.a21 + a.a21 * b.a22 + a.a31 * b.a23,
        a22: a.a12 * b.a21 + a.a22 * b.a22 + a.a32 * b.a23,
        a23: a.a13 * b.a21 + a.a23 * b.a22 + a.a33 * b.a23,
        a31: a.a11 * b.a31 + a.a21 * b.a32 + a.a31 * b.a33,
        a32: a.a12 * b.a31 + a.a22 * b.a32 + a.a32 * b.a33,
        a33: a.a13 * b.a31 + a.a23 * b.a32 + a.a33 * b.a33,
    };
}
function extract(image, location) {
    var qToS = quadrilateralToSquare({ x: 3.5, y: 3.5 }, { x: location.dimension - 3.5, y: 3.5 }, { x: location.dimension - 6.5, y: location.dimension - 6.5 }, { x: 3.5, y: location.dimension - 3.5 });
    var sToQ = squareToQuadrilateral(location.topLeft, location.topRight, location.alignmentPattern, location.bottomLeft);
    var transform = times(sToQ, qToS);
    var matrix = BitMatrix_1.BitMatrix.createEmpty(location.dimension, location.dimension);
    var mappingFunction = function (x, y) {
        var denominator = transform.a13 * x + transform.a23 * y + transform.a33;
        return {
            x: (transform.a11 * x + transform.a21 * y + transform.a31) / denominator,
            y: (transform.a12 * x + transform.a22 * y + transform.a32) / denominator,
        };
    };
    for (var y = 0; y < location.dimension; y++) {
        for (var x = 0; x < location.dimension; x++) {
            var xValue = x + 0.5;
            var yValue = y + 0.5;
            var sourcePixel = mappingFunction(xValue, yValue);
            matrix.set(x, y, image.get(Math.floor(sourcePixel.x), Math.floor(sourcePixel.y)));
        }
    }
    return {
        matrix: matrix,
        mappingFunction: mappingFunction,
    };
}
exports.extract = extract;

var MAX_FINDERPATTERNS_TO_SEARCH = 4;
var MIN_QUAD_RATIO = 0.5;var MAX_QUAD_RATIO = 1.5;
var distance = function (a, b) { return Math.sqrt(Math.pow((b.x - a.x), 2) + Math.pow((b.y - a.y), 2)); };
function sum(values) {
    return values.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; });
}
// Takes three finder patterns and organizes them into topLeft, topRight, etc
function reorderFinderPatterns(pattern1, pattern2, pattern3) {
    var _a, _b, _c, _d;
    // Find distances between pattern centers
    var oneTwoDistance = distance(pattern1, pattern2);
    var twoThreeDistance = distance(pattern2, pattern3);
    var oneThreeDistance = distance(pattern1, pattern3);
    var bottomLeft;
    var topLeft;
    var topRight;
    // Assume one closest to other two is B; A and C will just be guesses at first
    if (twoThreeDistance >= oneTwoDistance && twoThreeDistance >= oneThreeDistance) {
        _a = [pattern2, pattern1, pattern3], bottomLeft = _a[0], topLeft = _a[1], topRight = _a[2];
    }
    else if (oneThreeDistance >= twoThreeDistance && oneThreeDistance >= oneTwoDistance) {
        _b = [pattern1, pattern2, pattern3], bottomLeft = _b[0], topLeft = _b[1], topRight = _b[2];
    }
    else {
        _c = [pattern1, pattern3, pattern2], bottomLeft = _c[0], topLeft = _c[1], topRight = _c[2];
    }
    // Use cross product to figure out whether bottomLeft (A) and topRight (C) are correct or flipped in relation to topLeft (B)
    // This asks whether BC x BA has a positive z component, which is the arrangement we want. If it's negative, then
    // we've got it flipped around and should swap topRight and bottomLeft.
    if (((topRight.x - topLeft.x) * (bottomLeft.y - topLeft.y)) - ((topRight.y - topLeft.y) * (bottomLeft.x - topLeft.x)) < 0) {
        _d = [topRight, bottomLeft], bottomLeft = _d[0], topRight = _d[1];
    }
    return { bottomLeft: bottomLeft, topLeft: topLeft, topRight: topRight };
}
// Computes the dimension (number of modules on a side) of the QR Code based on the position of the finder patterns
function computeDimension(topLeft, topRight, bottomLeft, matrix) {
    var moduleSize = (sum(countBlackWhiteRun(topLeft, bottomLeft, matrix, 5)) / 7 + // Divide by 7 since the ratio is 1:1:3:1:1
        sum(countBlackWhiteRun(topLeft, topRight, matrix, 5)) / 7 +
        sum(countBlackWhiteRun(bottomLeft, topLeft, matrix, 5)) / 7 +
        sum(countBlackWhiteRun(topRight, topLeft, matrix, 5)) / 7) / 4;
    if (moduleSize < 1) {
        throw new Error("Invalid module size");
    }
    var topDimension = Math.round(distance(topLeft, topRight) / moduleSize);
    var sideDimension = Math.round(distance(topLeft, bottomLeft) / moduleSize);
    var dimension = Math.floor((topDimension + sideDimension) / 2) + 7;
    switch (dimension % 4) {
        case 0:
            dimension++;
            break;
        case 2:
            dimension--;
            break;
    }
    return { dimension: dimension, moduleSize: moduleSize };
}
// Takes an origin point and an end point and counts the sizes of the black white run from the origin towards the end point.
// Returns an array of elements, representing the pixel size of the black white run.
// Uses a variant of http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bresenham's_line_algorithm
function countBlackWhiteRunTowardsPoint(origin, end, matrix, length) {
    var switchPoints = [{ x: Math.floor(origin.x), y: Math.floor(origin.y) }];
    var steep = Math.abs(end.y - origin.y) > Math.abs(end.x - origin.x);
    var fromX;
    var fromY;
    var toX;
    var toY;
    if (steep) {
        fromX = Math.floor(origin.y);
        fromY = Math.floor(origin.x);
        toX = Math.floor(end.y);
        toY = Math.floor(end.x);
    }
    else {
        fromX = Math.floor(origin.x);
        fromY = Math.floor(origin.y);
        toX = Math.floor(end.x);
        toY = Math.floor(end.y);
    }
    var dx = Math.abs(toX - fromX);
    var dy = Math.abs(toY - fromY);
    var error = Math.floor(-dx / 2);
    var xStep = fromX < toX ? 1 : -1;
    var yStep = fromY < toY ? 1 : -1;
    var currentPixel = true;
    // Loop up until x == toX, but not beyond
    for (var x = fromX, y = fromY; x !== toX + xStep; x += xStep) {
        // Does current pixel mean we have moved white to black or vice versa?
        // Scanning black in state 0,2 and white in state 1, so if we find the wrong
        // color, advance to next state or end if we are in state 2 already
        var realX = steep ? y : x;
        var realY = steep ? x : y;
        if (matrix.get(realX, realY) !== currentPixel) {
            currentPixel = !currentPixel;
            switchPoints.push({ x: realX, y: realY });
            if (switchPoints.length === length + 1) {
                break;
            }
        }
        error += dy;
        if (error > 0) {
            if (y === toY) {
                break;
            }
            y += yStep;
            error -= dx;
        }
    }
    var distances = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < length; i++) {
        if (switchPoints[i] && switchPoints[i + 1]) {
            distances.push(distance(switchPoints[i], switchPoints[i + 1]));
        }
        else {
            distances.push(0);
        }
    }
    return distances;
}
// Takes an origin point and an end point and counts the sizes of the black white run in the origin point
// along the line that intersects with the end point. Returns an array of elements, representing the pixel sizes
// of the black white run. Takes a length which represents the number of switches from black to white to look for.
function countBlackWhiteRun(origin, end, matrix, length) {
    var _a;
    var rise = end.y - origin.y;
    var run = end.x - origin.x;
    var towardsEnd = countBlackWhiteRunTowardsPoint(origin, end, matrix, Math.ceil(length / 2));
    var awayFromEnd = countBlackWhiteRunTowardsPoint(origin, { x: origin.x - run, y: origin.y - rise }, matrix, Math.ceil(length / 2));
    var middleValue = towardsEnd.shift() + awayFromEnd.shift() - 1; // Substract one so we don't double count a pixel
    return (_a = awayFromEnd.concat(middleValue)).concat.apply(_a, towardsEnd);
}
// Takes in a black white run and an array of expected ratios. Returns the average size of the run as well as the "error" -
// that is the amount the run diverges from the expected ratio
function scoreBlackWhiteRun(sequence, ratios) {
    var averageSize = sum(sequence) / sum(ratios);
    var error = 0;
    ratios.forEach(function (ratio, i) {
        error += Math.pow((sequence[i] - ratio * averageSize), 2);
    });
    return { averageSize: averageSize, error: error };
}
// Takes an X,Y point and an array of sizes and scores the point against those ratios.
// For example for a finder pattern takes the ratio list of 1:1:3:1:1 and checks horizontal, vertical and diagonal ratios
// against that.
function scorePattern(point, ratios, matrix) {
    try {
        var horizontalRun = countBlackWhiteRun(point, { x: -1, y: point.y }, matrix, ratios.length);
        var verticalRun = countBlackWhiteRun(point, { x: point.x, y: -1 }, matrix, ratios.length);
        var topLeftPoint = {
            x: Math.max(0, point.x - point.y) - 1,
            y: Math.max(0, point.y - point.x) - 1,
        };
        var topLeftBottomRightRun = countBlackWhiteRun(point, topLeftPoint, matrix, ratios.length);
        var bottomLeftPoint = {
            x: Math.min(matrix.width, point.x + point.y) + 1,
            y: Math.min(matrix.height, point.y + point.x) + 1,
        };
        var bottomLeftTopRightRun = countBlackWhiteRun(point, bottomLeftPoint, matrix, ratios.length);
        var horzError = scoreBlackWhiteRun(horizontalRun, ratios);
        var vertError = scoreBlackWhiteRun(verticalRun, ratios);
        var diagDownError = scoreBlackWhiteRun(topLeftBottomRightRun, ratios);
        var diagUpError = scoreBlackWhiteRun(bottomLeftTopRightRun, ratios);
        var ratioError = Math.sqrt(horzError.error * horzError.error +
            vertError.error * vertError.error +
            diagDownError.error * diagDownError.error +
            diagUpError.error * diagUpError.error);
        var avgSize = (horzError.averageSize + vertError.averageSize + diagDownError.averageSize + diagUpError.averageSize) / 4;
        var sizeError = (Math.pow((horzError.averageSize - avgSize), 2) +
            Math.pow((vertError.averageSize - avgSize), 2) +
            Math.pow((diagDownError.averageSize - avgSize), 2) +
            Math.pow((diagUpError.averageSize - avgSize), 2)) / avgSize;
        return ratioError + sizeError;
    }
    catch (_a) {
        return Infinity;
    }
}
function recenterLocation(matrix, p) {
    var leftX = Math.round(p.x);
    while (matrix.get(leftX, Math.round(p.y))) {
        leftX--;
    }
    var rightX = Math.round(p.x);
    while (matrix.get(rightX, Math.round(p.y))) {
        rightX++;
    }
    var x = (leftX + rightX) / 2;
    var topY = Math.round(p.y);
    while (matrix.get(Math.round(x), topY)) {
        topY--;
    }
    var bottomY = Math.round(p.y);
    while (matrix.get(Math.round(x), bottomY)) {
        bottomY++;
    }
    var y = (topY + bottomY) / 2;
    return { x: x, y: y };
}
function locate(matrix) {
    var finderPatternQuads = [];
    var activeFinderPatternQuads = [];
    var alignmentPatternQuads = [];
    var activeAlignmentPatternQuads = [];
    var _loop_1 = function (y) {
        var length_1 = 0;
        var lastBit = false;
        var scans = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
        var _loop_2 = function (x) {
            var v = matrix.get(x, y);
            if (v === lastBit) {
                length_1++;
            }
            else {
                scans = [scans[1], scans[2], scans[3], scans[4], length_1];
                length_1 = 1;
                lastBit = v;
                // Do the last 5 color changes ~ match the expected ratio for a finder pattern? 1:1:3:1:1 of b:w:b:w:b
                var averageFinderPatternBlocksize = sum(scans) / 7;
                var validFinderPattern = Math.abs(scans[0] - averageFinderPatternBlocksize) < averageFinderPatternBlocksize &&
                    Math.abs(scans[1] - averageFinderPatternBlocksize) < averageFinderPatternBlocksize &&
                    Math.abs(scans[2] - 3 * averageFinderPatternBlocksize) < 3 * averageFinderPatternBlocksize &&
                    Math.abs(scans[3] - averageFinderPatternBlocksize) < averageFinderPatternBlocksize &&
                    Math.abs(scans[4] - averageFinderPatternBlocksize) < averageFinderPatternBlocksize &&
                    !v; // And make sure the current pixel is white since finder patterns are bordered in white
                // Do the last 3 color changes ~ match the expected ratio for an alignment pattern? 1:1:1 of w:b:w
                var averageAlignmentPatternBlocksize = sum(scans.slice(-3)) / 3;
                var validAlignmentPattern = Math.abs(scans[2] - averageAlignmentPatternBlocksize) < averageAlignmentPatternBlocksize &&
                    Math.abs(scans[3] - averageAlignmentPatternBlocksize) < averageAlignmentPatternBlocksize &&
                    Math.abs(scans[4] - averageAlignmentPatternBlocksize) < averageAlignmentPatternBlocksize &&
                    v; // Is the current pixel black since alignment patterns are bordered in black
                if (validFinderPattern) {
                    // Compute the start and end x values of the large center black square
                    var endX_1 = x - scans[3] - scans[4];
                    var startX_1 = endX_1 - scans[2];
                    var line = { startX: startX_1, endX: endX_1, y: y };
                    // Is there a quad directly above the current spot? If so, extend it with the new line. Otherwise, create a new quad with
                    // that line as the starting point.
                    var matchingQuads = activeFinderPatternQuads.filter(function (q) {
                        return (startX_1 >= q.bottom.startX && startX_1 <= q.bottom.endX) ||
                            (endX_1 >= q.bottom.startX && startX_1 <= q.bottom.endX) ||
                            (startX_1 <= q.bottom.startX && endX_1 >= q.bottom.endX && ((scans[2] / (q.bottom.endX - q.bottom.startX)) < MAX_QUAD_RATIO &&
                                (scans[2] / (q.bottom.endX - q.bottom.startX)) > MIN_QUAD_RATIO));
                    });
                    if (matchingQuads.length > 0) {
                        matchingQuads[0].bottom = line;
                    }
                    else {
                        activeFinderPatternQuads.push({ top: line, bottom: line });
                    }
                }
                if (validAlignmentPattern) {
                    // Compute the start and end x values of the center black square
                    var endX_2 = x - scans[4];
                    var startX_2 = endX_2 - scans[3];
                    var line = { startX: startX_2, y: y, endX: endX_2 };

                    // that line as the starting point.

                        return (startX_2 >= q.bottom.startX && startX_2 <= q.bottom.endX) ||
                            (endX_2 >= q.bottom.startX && startX_2 <= q.bottom.endX) ||
                            (startX_2 <= q.bottom.startX && endX_2 >= q.bottom.endX && ((scans[2] / (q.bottom.endX - q.bottom.startX)) < MAX_QUAD_RATIO &&
                                (scans[2] / (q.bottom.endX - q.bottom.startX)) > MIN_QUAD_RATIO));
                    });
                    if (matchingQuads.length > 0) {
                        matchingQuads[0].bottom = line;
                    }
                    else {
                        activeAlignmentPatternQuads.push({ top: line, bottom: line });
                    }
                }
            }
        };
        for (var x = -1; x <= matrix.width; x++) {
            _loop_2(x);
        }
        finderPatternQuads.push.apply(finderPatternQuads, activeFinderPatternQuads.filter(function (q) { return q.bottom.y !== y && q.bottom.y - q.top.y >= 2; }));
        activeFinderPatternQuads = activeFinderPatternQuads.filter(function (q) { return q.bottom.y === y; });
        alignmentPatternQuads.push.apply(alignmentPatternQuads, activeAlignmentPatternQuads.filter(function (q) { return q.bottom.y !== y; }));
        activeAlignmentPatternQuads = activeAlignmentPatternQuads.filter(function (q) { return q.bottom.y === y; });
    };
    for (var y = 0; y <= matrix.height; y++) {
        _loop_1(y);
    }
    finderPatternQuads.push.apply(finderPatternQuads, activeFinderPatternQuads.filter(function (q) { return q.bottom.y - q.top.y >= 2; }));
    alignmentPatternQuads.push.apply(alignmentPatternQuads, activeAlignmentPatternQuads);
    var finderPatternGroups = finderPatternQuads
        .filter(function (q) { return q.bottom.y - q.top.y >= 2; }) // All quads must be at least 2px tall since the center square is larger than a block
        .map(function (q) {
        var x = (q.top.startX + q.top.endX + q.bottom.startX + q.bottom.endX) / 4;
        var y = (q.top.y + q.bottom.y + 1) / 2;
        if (!matrix.get(Math.round(x), Math.round(y))) {
            return;
        }
        var lengths = [q.top.endX - q.top.startX, q.bottom.endX - q.bottom.startX, q.bottom.y - q.top.y + 1];
        var size = sum(lengths) / lengths.length;
        var score = scorePattern({ x: Math.round(x), y: Math.round(y) }, [1, 1, 3, 1, 1], matrix);
        return { score: score, x: x, y: y, size: size };
    })
        .filter(function (q) { return !!q; }) // Filter out any rejected quads from above
        .sort(function (a, b) { return a.score - b.score; })
        // Now take the top finder pattern options and try to find 2 other options with a similar size.
        .map(function (point, i, finderPatterns) {
        if (i > MAX_FINDERPATTERNS_TO_SEARCH) {
            return null;
        }
        var otherPoints = finderPatterns
            .filter(function (p, ii) { return i !== ii; })
            .map(function (p) { return ({ x: p.x, y: p.y, score: p.score + (Math.pow((p.size - point.size), 2)) / point.size, size: p.size }); })
            .sort(function (a, b) { return a.score - b.score; });
        if (otherPoints.length < 2) {
            return null;
        }
        var score = point.score + otherPoints[0].score + otherPoints[1].score;
        return { points: [point].concat(otherPoints.slice(0, 2)), score: score };
    })
        .filter(function (q) { return !!q; }) // Filter out any rejected finder patterns from above
        .sort(function (a, b) { return a.score - b.score; });
    if (finderPatternGroups.length === 0) {
        return null;
    }
    var _a = reorderFinderPatterns(finderPatternGroups[0].points[0], finderPatternGroups[0].points[1], finderPatternGroups[0].points[2]), topRight = _a.topRight, topLeft = _a.topLeft, bottomLeft = _a.bottomLeft;
    var alignment = findAlignmentPattern(matrix, alignmentPatternQuads, topRight, topLeft, bottomLeft);
    var result = [];
    if (alignment) {
        result.push({
            alignmentPattern: { x: alignment.alignmentPattern.x, y: alignment.alignmentPattern.y },
            bottomLeft: { x: bottomLeft.x, y: bottomLeft.y },
            dimension: alignment.dimension,
            topLeft: { x: topLeft.x, y: topLeft.y },
            topRight: { x: topRight.x, y: topRight.y },
        });
    }
    // We normally use the center of the quads as the location of the tracking points, which is optimal for most cases and will account
    // for a skew in the image. However, In some cases, a slight skew might not be real and instead be caused by image compression
    // errors and/or low resolution. For those cases, we'd be better off centering the point exactly in the middle of the black area. We
    // compute and return the location data for the naively centered points as it is little additional work and allows for multiple
    // attempts at decoding harder images.
    var midTopRight = recenterLocation(matrix, topRight);
    var midTopLeft = recenterLocation(matrix, topLeft);
    var midBottomLeft = recenterLocation(matrix, bottomLeft);
    var centeredAlignment = findAlignmentPattern(matrix, alignmentPatternQuads, midTopRight, midTopLeft, midBottomLeft);
    if (centeredAlignment) {
        result.push({
            alignmentPattern: { x: centeredAlignment.alignmentPattern.x, y: centeredAlignment.alignmentPattern.y },
            bottomLeft: { x: midBottomLeft.x, y: midBottomLeft.y },
            topLeft: { x: midTopLeft.x, y: midTopLeft.y },
            topRight: { x: midTopRight.x, y: midTopRight.y },
            dimension: centeredAlignment.dimension,
        });
    }
    if (result.length === 0) {
        return null;
    }
    return result;
}
exports.locate = locate;
function findAlignmentPattern(matrix, alignmentPatternQuads, topRight, topLeft, bottomLeft) {
    var _a;
    // Now that we've found the three finder patterns we can determine the blockSize and the size of the QR code.
    // We'll use these to help find the alignment pattern but also later when we do the extraction.
    var dimension;
    var moduleSize;
    try {
        (_a = computeDimension(topLeft, topRight, bottomLeft, matrix), dimension = _a.dimension, moduleSize = _a.moduleSize);
    }
    catch (e) {
        return null;
    }
    // Now find the alignment pattern
    var bottomRightFinderPattern = {
        x: topRight.x - topLeft.x + bottomLeft.x,
        y: topRight.y - topLeft.y + bottomLeft.y,
    };
    var modulesBetweenFinderPatterns = ((distance(topLeft, bottomLeft) + distance(topLeft, topRight)) / 2 / moduleSize);
    var correctionToTopLeft = 1 - (3 / modulesBetweenFinderPatterns);
    var expectedAlignmentPattern = {
        x: topLeft.x + correctionToTopLeft * (bottomRightFinderPattern.x - topLeft.x),
        y: topLeft.y + correctionToTopLeft * (bottomRightFinderPattern.y - topLeft.y),
    };
    var alignmentPatterns = alignmentPatternQuads
        .map(function (q) {
        var x = (q.top.startX + q.top.endX + q.bottom.startX + q.bottom.endX) / 4;
        var y = (q.top.y + q.bottom.y + 1) / 2;
        if (!matrix.get(Math.floor(x), Math.floor(y))) {
            return;
        }
        var lengths = [q.top.endX - q.top.startX, q.bottom.endX - q.bottom.startX, (q.bottom.y - q.top.y + 1)];
        var size = sum(lengths) / lengths.length;
        var sizeScore = scorePattern({ x: Math.floor(x), y: Math.floor(y) }, [1, 1, 1], matrix);
        var score = sizeScore + distance({ x: x, y: y }, expectedAlignmentPattern);
        return { x: x, y: y, score: score };
    })
        .filter(function (v) { return !!v; })
        .sort(function (a, b) { return a.score - b.score; });
    // If there are less than 15 modules between finder patterns it's a version 1 QR code and as such has no alignmemnt pattern
    // so we can only use our best guess.
    var alignmentPattern = modulesBetweenFinderPatterns >= 15 && alignmentPatterns.length ? alignmentPatterns[0] : expectedAlignmentPattern;
    return { alignmentPattern: alignmentPattern, dimension: dimension };
}


/***/ })
/******/ ])["default"];
});
;var m=module.exports;window.jsQR=typeof m==='function'?m:(m&&(m.default||m.jsQR));})();
</script>

function absStore(){ if(!GRADEBOOK.control||typeof GRADEBOOK.control!=='object') GRADEBOOK.control={}; if(!GRADEBOOK.control.abs) GRADEBOOK.control.abs={}; return GRADEBOOK.control.abs; }
function absKey(grade,sid){ return encodeURIComponent(grade)+'|'+encodeURIComponent(sid); }
function isAbs(grade,sid,stId,sub){ try{ var a=GRADEBOOK.control&&GRADEBOOK.control.abs&&GRADEBOOK.control.abs[absKey(grade,sid)]; return !!(a&&a[stId]&&a[stId].indexOf(sub)>=0); }catch(e){ return false; } }
function toggleAbs(grade,sid,stId,sub){

function finalOf(grade,sid,sub,stId){
  var rec=gbRecord(grade,sid,sub,false), row=rec&&rec.rows?rec.rows[stId]:null;
  if(!row) return '';
  try{ if(typeof window.nbGbOfficialScore==='function'){ var o=window.nbGbOfficialScore(grade,sid,sub,stId); return o===''||o==null?'':validScore(o); } }catch(e){}
  try{ if(usesSixthGradeLayout(grade)&&typeof gbCompute56==='function') gbCompute56(row,rec); }catch(e){}
  var v=(row.finalGrade!==undefined&&row.finalGrade!==null&&row.finalGrade!=='')?row.finalGrade:row.finalExam;
  return validScore(v);
}
function regNo(st){ return st.registrationNo||st.recordNo||st.regNo||st.qaydNo||''; }
function birthOf(st){ var b=String(st.birthDate||st.birth||st.dob||'').trim(); if(!b) return ''; var m=/^(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})$/.exec(b); return m?(m[3]+'/'+m[2]+'/'+m[1]):b; }
function build(grade,sid){
  var sec=gbSectionById(grade,sid); if(!sec) return null;
  var subs=gbSubjects(grade)||[], pass=resultPassMark(grade);
  var students=(sec.students||[]).filter(function(s){ return String(s.name||'').trim(); });
  var rows=students.map(function(st,i){
    var cells=[], sum=0, has=0, absent=false, failed=false;
    subs.forEach(function(sub){
      var ab=isAbs(grade,sid,st.id,sub), v=ab?'':finalOf(grade,sid,sub,st.id);
      if(ab) absent=true;
      if(v!==''){ sum+=Number(v); has++; if(Number(v)<pass) failed=true; }
      cells.push({sub:sub,v:v,abs:ab,fail:v!==''&&Number(v)<pass});
    });
    var res='';
    if(absent) res='راسب بالغياب';
    else if(has){ try{ res=classifyStudentResult(cells.filter(function(c){return c.v!=='';}).map(function(c){return Number(c.v);}),grade).label; }catch(e){ res=failed?'راسب':'ناجح'; } if(res==='—') res=''; }
    return {i:i+1,st:st,cells:cells,sum:has?Math.round(sum*100)/100:'',absent:absent,failed:failed,has:has,res:res};
  });
  var total=rows.length, absent=rows.filter(function(r){return r.absent;}).length, examined=total-absent;
  var passed=rows.filter(function(r){return !r.absent&&r.has>0&&!r.failed;}).length;
  var failExam=rows.filter(function(r){return !r.absent&&r.failed;}).length;
  function pct(a,b){ return b?Math.round(a/b*1000)/10:0; }
  return {sec:sec,subs:subs,rows:rows,pass:pass,stats:{total:total,examined:examined,absent:absent,passed:passed,failAbs:absent,failExam:failExam,pTotal:pct(passed,total),pExam:pct(passed,examined)}};
}

function tableHtml(d){
  var head='<thead><tr><th rowspan="2">ت</th><th rowspan="2">رقم القيد</th><th rowspan="2">التولد</th><th rowspan="2">الاسم الرباعي</th>'+

    '<th colspan="2">المجموع</th><th rowspan="2">النتيجة</th></tr><tr><th>رقماً</th><th>كتابةً</th></tr></thead>';
  var body=d.rows.map(function(r){
    return '<tr data-st="'+esc(r.st.id)+'"><td>'+ar(r.i)+'</td><td>'+esc(ar(regNo(r.st)))+'</td><td>'+esc(ar(birthOf(r.st)))+'</td><td class="ctl-name">'+esc(r.st.name)+'</td>'+
      r.cells.map(function(c){ return '<td class="ctl-g'+(c.abs?' abs':(c.fail?' fail':''))+'" data-sub="'+esc(c.sub)+'">'+(c.abs?'غ':(c.v===''?'':ar(c.v)))+'</td>'; }).join('')+
      '<td class="ctl-sum">'+(r.sum===''?'':ar(r.sum))+'</td><td class="ctl-words">'+esc(words(r.sum))+'</td><td class="ctl-res '+resCls(r.res)+'">'+esc(r.res)+'</td></tr>';
  }).join('');
  return '<table class="ctl-tbl" id="ctlTable">'+head+'<tbody>'+(body||'<tr><td colspan="'+(7+d.subs.length)+'">لا يوجد طلاب في هذه الشعبة</td></tr>')+'</tbody></table>';
}
function renderBody(){
  var host=document.getElementById('ctlHost'); if(!host) return;
  if(!ST.grade||!ST.sid){ host.innerHTML='<div class="ctl-empty">اختر الصف ثم الشعبة لعرض سجل الكنترول.</div>'; return; }
  var d=build(ST.grade,ST.sid);
  if(!d){ host.innerHTML='<div class="ctl-empty">تعذر العثور على الشعبة.</div>'; return; }
  host.innerHTML='<div class="ctl-wrap">'+tableHtml(d)+'</div>'+
    '<div class="ctl-wrap ctl-stats" style="max-height:none"><table class="ctl-tbl" id="ctlStats">'+statsHead()+'<tbody><tr>'+statsCells(d.stats)+'</tr></tbody></table></div>'+
    '<p class="ctl-hint">✍️ أرقام الإحصائية تُحسب تلقائياً، ويمكنك تعديل أي رقم بالضغط عليه قبل الطباعة. درجة النجاح: '+ar(d.pass)+'.</p>';
  try{ var t=document.getElementById('ctlTable'), r1=t&&t.querySelector('thead tr'); if(r1) t.style.setProperty('--ctlH1',(r1.getBoundingClientRect().height||34)+'px'); }catch(e){}
  var tb=host.querySelector('#ctlTable tbody');
  if(tb) tb.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    if(!ST.marking) return;
    var td=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('td.ctl-g'); if(!td) return;
    var tr=td.parentNode; toggleAbs(ST.grade,ST.sid,tr.getAttribute('data-st'),td.getAttribute('data-sub')); renderBody();
  });
}
function render(){
  ensureCss();
  var el=view();
  el.innerHTML='<div class="module-shell ctl-shell">'+
    '<div class="ctl-hero"><h2>سجل الكنترول</h2><p>الدرجات النهائية لكل مواد الشعبة في جدول واحد، مع المجموع وإحصائية النتائج — للطباعة والحفظ PDF.</p></div>'+
    '<div class="module-head"><div class="module-title"><span class="mi">🧾</span><div><h2>الكنترول</h2><p>اختر الصف ثم الشعبة</p></div></div><button class="material-btn secondary" onclick="appGoBack()">رجوع خطوة</button></div>'+
    '<div class="ctl-pick"><div><label>الصف (المرحلة)</label><select id="ctlGrade" onchange="nbControlPick(\'grade\',this.value)"><option value="">اختر الصف</option>'+gradeOptions()+'</select></div>'+
    '<div><label>الشعبة</label><select id="ctlSection" onchange="nbControlPick(\'sid\',this.value)"><option value="">اختر الشعبة</option>'+sectionOptions()+'</select></div></div>'+
    '<div class="ctl-actions"><button class="material-btn" onclick="nbControlPrint()">🖨️ طباعة</button><button class="material-btn purple" onclick="nbControlPdf()">📄 حفظ PDF</button>'+
    '<button class="material-btn secondary'+(ST.marking?' on':'')+'" id="ctlMarkBtn" onclick="nbControlMark()">'+(ST.marking?'✅ إنهاء تأشير الغياب':'✏️ تأشير الغياب «غ»')+'</button></div>'+
    (ST.marking?'<p class="ctl-hint" style="color:#c62828;font-weight:800">اضغط على درجة أي مادة لتأشير الطالب غائباً فيها «غ»، واضغط مرة أخرى للإلغاء. (لا يغيّر سجل المدرس)</p>':'')+
    '<div id="ctlHost"></div></div>';
  el.classList.toggle('ctl-marking',!!ST.marking);
  renderBody();
}
window.nbControlPick=function(kind,v){
  if(kind==='grade'){ ST.grade=v||''; var secs=ST.grade?gbSectionsForGrade(ST.grade):[]; ST.sid=secs.length===1?String(secs[0].id):''; }
  else ST.sid=v||'';
  rememberPick(); render();
};
window.nbControlMark=function(){ ST.marking=!ST.marking; render(); };
window.openControlRegister=function(){
  var labels=gradebookGradeLabels(); if(ST.grade&&labels.indexOf(ST.grade)<0){ ST.grade=''; ST.sid=''; }
  if(ST.grade&&ST.sid&&!gbSectionById(ST.grade,ST.sid)) ST.sid='';
  ST.marking=false; render(); navigateTo('view-control');
};

/* ---------- الطباعة و PDF: نفس ترويسة وإطار باقي السجلات (سجل المعلم) ---------- */
function statsValues(){
  var out=[]; document.querySelectorAll('#ctlStats [data-ctl-stat]').forEach(function(td){ out[Number(td.getAttribute('data-ctl-stat'))]=td.textContent.trim(); }); return out;
}
function printParts(){
  if(!ST.grade||!ST.sid) return null;
  var d=build(ST.grade,ST.sid); if(!d) return null;
  var sv=statsValues(); if(sv.length<8){ var s=d.stats; sv=[s.total,s.examined,s.absent,s.passed,s.failAbs,s.failExam,s.pTotal+'٪',s.pExam+'٪'].map(ar); }
  var n=d.subs.length, colN=7+n;
  var thead='<tr><th rowspan="2" class="ctl-c-i">ت</th><th rowspan="2" class="ctl-c-reg">رقم القيد</th><th rowspan="2" class="ctl-c-birth">التولد</th><th rowspan="2" class="ctl-c-name">الاسم الرباعي</th>'+
    d.subs.map(function(s){ return '<th rowspan="2" class="ctl-c-sub"><span class="ctl-vt">'+esc(s)+'</span></th>'; }).join('')+
    '<th colspan="2" class="ctl-c-sumh">المجموع</th><th rowspan="2" class="ctl-c-res">النتيجة</th></tr><tr><th class="ctl-c-sum">رقماً</th><th class="ctl-c-words">كتابةً</th></tr>';
  var rows=d.rows.map(function(r){
    return '<tr><td class="ctl-c-i">'+ar(r.i)+'</td><td>'+esc(ar(regNo(r.st)))+'</td><td>'+esc(ar(birthOf(r.st)))+'</td><td class="ctl-c-name nm">'+esc(r.st.name)+'</td>'+
      r.cells.map(function(c){ return '<td class="ctl-g'+(c.abs?' ctl-a':(c.fail?' ctl-f':''))+'">'+(c.abs?'غ':(c.v===''?'':ar(c.v)))+'</td>'; }).join('')+
      '<td class="ctl-s">'+(r.sum===''?'':ar(r.sum))+'</td><td class="ctl-w">'+esc(words(r.sum))+'</td><td class="ctl-r '+resCls(r.res)+'">'+esc(r.res)+'</td></tr>';
  });
  if(!rows.length) rows=['<tr><td colspan="'+colN+'">لا يوجد طلاب في هذه الشعبة</td></tr>'];
  var stats='<tr class="ctl-gap-row"><td colspan="'+colN+'"></td></tr><tr class="ctl-stat-row"><td colspan="'+colN+'" class="ctl-stat-cell"><table class="ctl-st"><thead><tr><th rowspan="2">عدد المشتركين</th><th rowspan="2">عدد الممتحنين</th><th rowspan="2">عدد الغائبين</th><th rowspan="2">عدد الناجحين</th><th rowspan="2">عدد الراسبين بالغياب</th><th rowspan="2">عدد الراسبين بالامتحان</th><th colspan="2">النسبة المئوية للنجاح</th></tr><tr><th>من المشتركين</th><th>من الممتحنين</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr>'+
    sv.map(function(v){ return '<td>'+esc(v)+'</td>'; }).join('')+'</tr></tbody></table></td></tr>';
  return {d:d,thead:thead,rows:rows,stats:stats};
}
function ctlPrintCss(){
  return '.ctl-print-table{width:100%!important;table-layout:auto!important}'+
    '.ctl-print-table thead th{font-size:9px!important;line-height:1.15!important;padding:.6mm .3mm!important;vertical-align:middle!important;text-align:center!important}'+
    '.ctl-print-table td{font-size:10px!important;padding:.55mm .4mm!important;white-space:nowrap}'+
    '.ctl-print-table th.ctl-c-sub{height:30mm!important;min-width:6.4mm;padding:.6mm .2mm!important}'+
    '.ctl-print-table .ctl-vt{writing-mode:vertical-rl;transform:rotate(180deg);white-space:nowrap;display:inline-block;margin:0 auto;line-height:1.1;font-size:9px}'+
    '.ctl-print-table .ctl-c-i{width:6mm}.ctl-print-table th.ctl-c-name,.ctl-print-table td.ctl-c-name{width:1%!important;white-space:nowrap!important;text-align:right!important;padding-right:1.2mm!important;padding-left:1.2mm!important}'+
    '.ctl-print-table td.ctl-g{font-weight:900}.ctl-print-table td.ctl-f,.ctl-print-table td.ctl-a{color:#b71c1c!important}'+
    '.ctl-print-table td.ctl-s{font-weight:900;background:#fbf4dc!important}.ctl-print-table td.ctl-w{text-align:right!important;font-size:9px!important}'+
    '.ctl-print-table td.ctl-r{font-weight:900}.ctl-print-table td.ctl-r.r-pass{color:#1b5e20!important}.ctl-print-table td.ctl-r.r-comp{color:#e65100!important}.ctl-print-table td.ctl-r.r-fail{color:#b71c1c!important}'+
    '.ctl-print-table tr.ctl-gap-row td{height:2mm!important;padding:0!important;border:0!important;background:transparent!important}'+
    '.ctl-print-table td.ctl-stat-cell{padding:0!important;border:0!important;background:transparent!important}'+
    '.ctl-print-table table.ctl-st{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:0}'+
    '.ctl-print-table table.ctl-st th{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--list-dark),var(--list-mid))!important;color:#fff!important;font-size:9.5px!important;height:auto!important}'+
    '.ctl-print-table table.ctl-st td{font-size:12px!important;font-weight:900;padding:1.2mm .4mm!important;background:#fff!important}'+
    '.ctl-foot span{flex:1;text-align:center}';
}
function ctlFoot(){
  return '<footer class="exam-list-footer ctl-foot"><span>عضو لجنة الكنترول: ..................</span><span>رئيس لجنة الكنترول: ..................</span><span>مدير المدرسة: '+esc(APP.school.principal||'..................')+'</span></footer>';
}
window.nbControlPrint=function(){
  var P=printParts(); if(!P){ alert('اختر الصف والشعبة أولاً.'); return; }
  var year=APP.school.academicYear||(typeof EXAMS_STATE!=='undefined'&&EXAMS_STATE.monthly&&EXAMS_STATE.monthly.academicYear)||APP.school.year||'';
  var logo=APP.school.logo?'<img src="'+APP.school.logo+'">':'شعار';
  var pageW='287mm', pageH='200mm';
  var css=schoolSheetPrintCss(pageW,pageH,true,'.exam-list-table')+ctlPrintCss();
  var head=schoolSheetPrintHead('سجل الكنترول',year,'',ST.grade,P.d.sec.label,logo,'',true);
  openFilledSheetPrint('سجل الكنترول',css,pageW,pageH,head,ctlFoot(),P.thead,P.rows,'exam-list-table ctl-print-table',P.stats);
};
window.nbControlPdf=function(){
  if(!ST.grade||!ST.sid){ alert('اختر الصف والشعبة أولاً.'); return; }
  var sec=gbSectionById(ST.grade,ST.sid);
  var b=document.createElement('button'); b.type='button'; b.style.display='none';
  b.setAttribute('onclick','nbControlPrint()');
  b.setAttribute('data-pdf-title','سجل-الكنترول-'+String(ST.grade).replace(/\s+/g,'-')+'-'+String(sec?sec.label:'').replace(/\s+/g,'-'));
  document.body.appendChild(b); setTimeout(function(){ b.remove(); },60000);
  window.__nbPdfUntil=Date.now()+15000;
  if(typeof window.downloadPdfFromPrintButton==='function') return window.downloadPdfFromPrintButton(b);
  window.nbControlPrint();
};
window.__nbControl={build:build,printParts:printParts};

/* ---------- بطاقة «الكنترول» داخل «سجلات الدرجات» ---------- */
function addTile(){
  var v=document.getElementById('view-records-hub'); if(!v) return;
  var grid=v.querySelector('.nbrh-grid'); if(!grid) return;
  if(!grid.querySelector('[data-lv-tile]')&&typeof window.openLevelsModule==='function'){
    var l=document.createElement('button'); l.type='button'; l.className='nbrh-tile'; l.setAttribute('data-lv-tile','1'); l.setAttribute('onclick','openLevelsModule()');
    l.innerHTML='<span class="nbrh-ic">📈</span><span><b>سجل المستويات</b><small>المستويات الأسبوعية والشهرية لكل مادة وشعبة</small></span>';
    grid.appendChild(l);
  }
  if(grid.querySelector('[data-ctl-tile]')) return;
  var b=document.createElement('button'); b.type='button'; b.className='nbrh-tile'; b.setAttribute('data-ctl-tile','1');
  b.setAttribute('onclick','openControlRegister()');
  b.innerHTML='<span class="nbrh-ic">🧾</span><span><b>الكنترول</b><small>الدرجات النهائية لكل المواد مع المجموع وإحصائية النتائج</small></span>';
  grid.appendChild(b);
}
if(typeof window.openRecordsHub==='function'){
  window.openRecordsHub=(function(orig){ return function(){ var r=orig.apply(this,arguments); try{ addTile(); }catch(e){} return r; }; })(window.openRecordsHub);
}
})();

<script>
/* ===== nb-v1.42: جدول النسب في نهاية سجل المعلم/المدرس =====
   بدل صفّي «المجموع» و«النسبة المئوية»: جدول واحد —
   الفصل الأول | نصف السنة | الفصل الثاني | السعي السنوي، ولكل منها: العدد الكلي، الناجحون، الراسبون، النسبة.
   (الصفوف التي سجلها نصف السنة والنهائي فقط: نصف السنة | نهاية السنة). الحساب من درجات السجل نفسها، ولا يُغيّر أي درجة. */
(function(){
'use strict';
function esc(v){ return typeof escapeHtml==='function'?escapeHtml(String(v==null?'':v)):String(v==null?'':v); }
function ar(v){ try{ return typeof toArabicDigits==='function'?toArabicDigits(String(v)):String(v); }catch(e){ return String(v); } }
function num(v){ if(v===''||v==null) return null; var n=Number(typeof toWesternDigits==='function'?toWesternDigits(String(v)):v); return isFinite(n)?n:null; }
function ctx(){ return {grade:(document.getElementById('gbGrade')||{}).value||'', sid:(document.getElementById('gbSection')||{}).value||'', sub:(document.getElementById('gbSubject')||{}).value||''}; }
function groups(grade){
  return usesSixthGradeLayout(grade)
    ? [['term1','الفصل الأول'],['mid','نصف السنة'],['term2','الفصل الثاني'],['coursework','السعي السنوي']]
    : [['mid','نصف السنة'],['finalExam','نهاية السنة']];
}
function compute(c){
  if(!c.grade||!c.sid||!c.sub) return null;
  var sec=gbSectionById(c.grade,c.sid); if(!sec) return null;
  var rec=gbRecord(c.grade,c.sid,c.sub,false), G=groups(c.grade), pass=resultPassMark(c.grade);
  var studs=(sec.students||[]).filter(function(s){ return String(s.name||'').trim(); });
  var el56=typeof window.nbIsEl56==='function'&&window.nbIsEl56(c.grade), upper=usesSixthGradeLayout(c.grade);
  var out=G.map(function(g){ return {f:g[0],label:g[1],total:studs.length,graded:0,pass:0,fail:0}; });
  studs.forEach(function(st){
    var r=rec&&rec.rows?rec.rows[st.id]:null; if(!r) return;
    if(upper&&!el56){ try{ gbCompute56(r,rec); }catch(e){} }
    out.forEach(function(o){ var n=num(typeof validScore==='function'?validScore(r[o.f]):r[o.f]); if(n==null) return; o.graded++; if(n>=pass) o.pass++; else o.fail++; });
  });
  out.forEach(function(o){ o.pct=o.total?Math.round(o.pass/o.total*1000)/10:0; });
  return out;
}
function tableInner(data,blank){
  var h1='', h2='', b='';
  data.forEach(function(o){
    h1+='<th colspan="4" class="gbr-g">'+esc(o.label)+'</th>';
    h2+='<th>العدد الكلي</th><th>الناجحون</th><th>الراسبون</th><th>النسبة</th>';
    var has=!blank&&o.graded>0;
    b+='<td>'+(o.total?ar(o.total):'')+'</td><td>'+(has?ar(o.pass):'')+'</td><td>'+(has?ar(o.fail):'')+'</td><td class="gbr-p">'+(has?ar(o.pct)+'٪':'')+'</td>';
  });
  var cg='<colgroup>'+new Array(data.length*4+1).join('<col style="width:'+(100/(data.length*4)).toFixed(3)+'%">')+'</colgroup>';
  return cg+'<thead><tr>'+h1+'</tr><tr>'+h2+'</tr></thead><tbody><tr>'+b+'</tr></tbody>';
}
/* ---------- على الشاشة ---------- */
function ensureCss(){
  if(document.getElementById('gbRatioCss')) return;
  var st=document.createElement('style'); st.id='gbRatioCss';
  st.textContent='#gbRatioBox{margin:12px 0 4px}#gbRatioBox .gbr-title{font-weight:900;margin:0 2px 6px;font-size:14px}'+
    '#gbRatioBox .gbr-wrap{overflow:auto;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(127,127,127,.32)}'+
    '#gbRatioBox table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;min-width:560px;font-size:13px}'+
    '#gbRatioBox th,#gbRatioBox td{border:1px solid rgba(127,127,127,.35);padding:6px 4px;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap}'+
    '#gbRatioBox thead th{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#004d40,#00897b);color:#fff;font-weight:900}'+
    '#gbRatioBox thead th.gbr-g{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0d2b5c,#16488f);font-size:14px}'+
    '#gbRatioBox td{font-weight:900;font-size:15px}#gbRatioBox td.gbr-p{background:rgba(201,162,39,.14)}';
  document.head.appendChild(st);
}
function renderScreen(){
  var foot=document.getElementById('gbTableFoot'); if(!foot) return;
  foot.innerHTML='';
  var data=compute(ctx()), box=document.getElementById('gbRatioBox');
  if(!data){ if(box) box.remove(); return; }
  ensureCss();
  if(!box){
    box=document.createElement('div'); box.id='gbRatioBox';
    var card=document.getElementById('gbSectionPassCard'), tbl=foot.closest('table'), anchor=card||(tbl&&tbl.parentNode);
    if(!anchor) return;
    if(card) card.parentNode.insertBefore(box,card); else anchor.parentNode.insertBefore(box,anchor.nextSibling);
  }
  box.innerHTML='<div class="gbr-title">📊 جدول النسب</div><div class="gbr-wrap"><table>'+tableInner(data,false)+'</table></div>';
}
if(typeof window.updateGradebookSummary==='function'){
  window.updateGradebookSummary=(function(orig){ return function(){
    var r=orig.apply(this,arguments);
    try{ renderScreen(); if(r&&typeof r==='object') r.footHtml=''; }catch(e){ try{console.warn('nb-ratio',e);}catch(_){} }
    return r; }; })(window.updateGradebookSummary);
}
if(typeof window.renderGradebookTable==='function'){
  window.renderGradebookTable=(function(orig){ return function(){ var r=orig.apply(this,arguments); try{ renderScreen(); }catch(e){} return r; }; })(window.renderGradebookTable);
}
if(typeof window.nbEl56Update==='function'){
  window.nbEl56Update=(function(orig){ return function(){ var r=orig.apply(this,arguments); try{ renderScreen(); }catch(e){} return r; }; })(window.nbEl56Update);
}
/* ---------- الطباعة و PDF ---------- */
var PRINT_CSS='.gradebook-print-table tr.gb-ratio-row>td.gbr-cell{padding:0!important;border:0!important;background:transparent!important;height:auto!important}'+
  '.gradebook-print-table table.gbr{width:100%!important;border-collapse:collapse;margin:0;table-layout:fixed!important}'+
  '.gradebook-print-table table.gbr tr>*{width:auto!important;min-width:0!important;max-width:none!important;height:auto!important;writing-mode:horizontal-tb!important;transform:none!important;white-space:nowrap!important;text-align:center!important}'+
  '.gradebook-print-table table.gbr th{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--list-dark),var(--list-mid))!important;color:#fff!important;font-size:9px!important;font-weight:900;padding:.8mm .3mm!important;height:auto!important;white-space:nowrap}'+
  '.gradebook-print-table table.gbr th.gbr-g{font-size:10.5px!important}'+
  '.gradebook-print-table table.gbr td{font-size:11.5px!important;font-weight:900;padding:1.1mm .3mm!important;background:#fff!important;height:auto!important}'+
  '.gradebook-print-table table.gbr td.gbr-p{background:#fbf4dc!important}';
function printRatioRows(colN){
  var data=compute(ctx()); if(!data) return '';
  return '<tr class="gb-gap-row"><td colspan="'+colN+'"></td></tr><tr class="gb-ratio-row"><td colspan="'+colN+'" class="gbr-cell"><table class="gbr">'+tableInner(data,!!window.__nbBlankPrint)+'</table></td></tr>';
}
if(typeof window.openFilledSheetPrint==='function'){
  window.openFilledSheetPrint=(function(orig){ return function(title,css,pageW,pageH,head,foot,theadHtml,rowHtmls,tableClass,lastExtra){
    try{
      if(/gradebook-print-table/.test(tableClass||'')&&/gb-sum-row/.test(lastExtra||'')){
        var m=/gb-gap-row"><td colspan="(\d+)"/.exec(lastExtra), colN=m?Number(m[1]):((rowHtmls&&rowHtmls[0]&&(rowHtmls[0].match(/<td/g)||[]).length)||7);
        var rr=printRatioRows(colN);
        if(rr){ var a=[].slice.call(arguments); a[1]=String(css||'')+PRINT_CSS; a[9]=rr; return orig.apply(this,a); }
      }
    }catch(e){ try{console.warn('nb-ratio-print',e);}catch(_){} }
    return orig.apply(this,arguments);
  }; })(window.openFilledSheetPrint);
}
window.__nbRatio={compute:compute};
})();
</script>

<script>
/* ===== nb-v1.43 =====
   (1) تسمية الصفوف: لكل صف اسم عرض يختاره المستخدم (مثل «الرابع العلمي» ← «الرابع التطبيقي»).
       الاسم الأصلي يبقى مفتاح البيانات والحسابات كما هو (المواد، درجة النجاح، السجلات، المزامنة)، فلا يتأثر أي شيء محفوظ،
       ويظهر الاسم الجديد في كل مكان يُعرض فيه الصف: الشاشات والقوائم والطباعة وPDF.
   (2) رقم القيد في قسم التلاميذ/الطلاب: عمود بعد التسلسل، يُحفظ في بيانات الطالب (registrationNo)
       فيظهر تلقائياً في الكنترول والسجل الوسطي والسجل الفصلي وبطاقات الامتحان، ويُضاف/يُحدَّث تلقائياً في قسم القيود. */
(function(){
'use strict';
function esc(v){ return typeof escapeHtml==='function'?escapeHtml(String(v==null?'':v)):String(v==null?'':v); }
function west(v){ try{ return typeof toWesternDigits==='function'?toWesternDigits(String(v)):String(v); }catch(e){ return String(v); } }
function ar(v){ try{ return typeof toArabicDigits==='function'?toArabicDigits(String(v)):String(v); }catch(e){ return String(v); } }

/* =================== (1) تسمية الصفوف =================== */
function names(){ var m=APP&&APP.school&&APP.school.gradeNames; return (m&&typeof m==='object')?m:{}; }
window.nbGradeName=function(label){ var n=names()[label]; return (n&&String(n).trim())||label; };
var AR='\\u0621-\\u064A\\u0660-\\u0669';
function reEsc(s){ return String(s).replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,'\\$&'); }
var C=null; /* البنية المحسوبة للأسماء الحالية */
function build(){
  var m=names(), pairs=[];
  Object.keys(m).forEach(function(k){ var v=String(m[k]||'').trim(); if(k&&v&&v!==k) pairs.push([k,v]); });
  if(!pairs.length){ C=null; return; }
  var all=[]; try{ (APP.grades||[]).forEach(function(g){ all.push(g.label); }); }catch(e){}
  pairs.forEach(function(p){ all.push(p[1]); });
  pairs.sort(function(a,b){ return b[0].length-a[0].length; });
  var map={}; pairs.forEach(function(p){ map[p[0]]=p[1]; });
  /* لاحقات تكمل اسماً آخر: «الرابع» داخل «الرابع العلمي» ليست الصف الرابع */
  var cont={}; pairs.forEach(function(p){ var L=p[0]; cont[L]=all.filter(function(s){ return s!==L&&s.indexOf(L+' ')===0; }).map(function(s){ return s.slice(L.length); }); });
  var multi=pairs.filter(function(p){ return /\s/.test(p[0]); }).map(function(p){ return p[0]; });
  var single=pairs.filter(function(p){ return !/\s/.test(p[0]); }).map(function(p){ return p[0]; });
  var alt=function(list){ return list.map(reEsc).join('|'); };
  C={map:map,cont:cont,singleSet:single,
     test:new RegExp(pairs.map(function(p){ return reEsc(p[0]); }).join('|')),
     multi:multi.length?new RegExp('(^|[^'+AR+'])('+alt(multi)+')(?=$|[^'+AR+'])','g'):null,
     pre:single.length?new RegExp('((?:^|[^'+AR+'])(?:ال|لل|بال|و?ال)?صف(?:ّ)?\\s*[:：]?\\s*)('+alt(single)+')(?=$|[^'+AR+'])','g'):null,
     post:single.length?new RegExp('(^|[^'+AR+'])('+alt(single)+')(?=\\s*[/—–-]\\s*(?:شعبة|[\\u0621-\\u064A](?:$|[^'+AR+'])))','g'):null,
     seen:new WeakMap()};
}
function continues(label,rest){ var l=C.cont[label]||[]; for(var i=0;i<l.length;i++){ if(rest.indexOf(l[i])===0) return true; } return false; }
function fixText(t){
  if(!C||!t||!C.test.test(t)) return t;
  var o=t;
  if(C.multi) o=o.replace(C.multi,function(m,b,L,off,str){ return continues(L,str.slice(off+m.length))?m:b+C.map[L]; });
  if(C.pre) o=o.replace(C.pre,function(m,b,L,off,str){ return continues(L,str.slice(off+m.length))?m:b+C.map[L]; });
  if(C.post) o=o.replace(C.post,function(m,b,L,off,str){ return b+C.map[L]; });
  return o;
}
window.nbGradeNameText=function(t){ if(C===undefined) build(); return fixText(t); };
/* سياق «اسم صف منفرد» داخل عنصر: خيار قائمة، خانة صف في جدول، قيمة بعد «الصف:» */
function soloContext(node,label){
  var el=node.parentNode; if(!el||el.nodeType!==1) return false;
  if(el.tagName==='OPTION') return el.value===label||el.getAttribute('data-grade')===label;
  for(var a=el,i=0;a&&a.nodeType===1&&i<4;a=a.parentNode,i++){
    if(a.getAttribute('data-grade')===label||a.getAttribute('data-label')===label) return true;
    if(a.classList&&(a.classList.contains('meta-val')||a.classList.contains('sc-grade'))) return true;
  }
  /* نص سابق مباشر ينتهي بـ «الصف:» */
  var prev=node.previousSibling||(el.previousSibling);
  var pt=prev?(prev.textContent||''):'';
  if(/(?:^|[^\u0621-\u064A])(?:ال)?صف\s*[:：]?\s*$/.test(pt)) return true;
  /* خلية في عمود عنوانه «الصف» */
  var td=el.closest?el.closest('td'):null;
  if(td&&td.parentNode){ var t=td.closest('table'), head=t&&t.tHead&&t.tHead.rows.length?t.tHead.rows[t.tHead.rows.length-1]:null;
    if(head){ var idx=0; for(var c=td.parentNode.firstElementChild;c&&c!==td;c=c.nextElementSibling) idx+=(c.colSpan||1);
      var hc=null, k=0; for(var j=0;j<head.cells.length;j++){ if(k===idx){ hc=head.cells[j]; break; } k+=(head.cells[j].colSpan||1); }
      if(!hc&&t.tHead.rows.length>1){ var r0=t.tHead.rows[0]; k=0; for(var q=0;q<r0.cells.length;q++){ if(k===idx&&(r0.cells[q].rowSpan||1)>1){ hc=r0.cells[q]; break; } k+=(r0.cells[q].colSpan||1); } }
      if(hc&&/^\s*الصف\s*$/.test(hc.textContent||'')) return true; } }
  return false;
}
function fixNode(n){
  if(!C) return;
  var v=n.nodeValue; if(!v||!C.test.test(v)) return;
  if(C.seen.get(n)===v) return;
  try{ if(n.parentNode&&n.parentNode.closest&&n.parentNode.closest('.nbgn-keep,.nbgn-old')) return; }catch(e){}
  var tr=v.trim(), out;
  if(C.map[tr]&&soloContext(n,tr)) out=v.replace(tr,C.map[tr]);
  else out=fixText(v);
  if(out!==v){ C.seen.set(n,out); n.nodeValue=out; } else C.seen.set(n,v);
}
var SKIP={SCRIPT:1,STYLE:1,TEXTAREA:1,NOSCRIPT:1,TEMPLATE:1};
function editing(node){ var a=document.activeElement, el=node.parentNode; return !!(a&&a.isContentEditable&&el&&a.contains(el)); }
function walk(root,doc){
  if(!C||!root) return; doc=doc||document;
  if(root.nodeType===3){ if(root.parentNode&&!SKIP[root.parentNode.nodeName]&&!editing(root)) fixNode(root); return; }
  if(root.nodeType!==1&&root.nodeType!==9&&root.nodeType!==11) return;
  if(root.nodeType===1&&SKIP[root.nodeName]) return;
  var tw=doc.createTreeWalker(root,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT,{acceptNode:function(n){ return (n.parentNode&&!SKIP[n.parentNode.nodeName]&&C.test.test(n.nodeValue||''))?1:3; }},false), list=[], n;
  while((n=tw.nextNode())) list.push(n);
  list.forEach(function(x){ if(!editing(x)) fixNode(x); });
}
/* الطباعة وPDF: نفس مرحلة تحويل الكلمات قبل الطباعة */
function printDoc(doc){ try{ if(C&&doc&&doc.body){ walk(doc.body,doc); if(doc.title) doc.title=fixText(doc.title); } }catch(e){} }
window.nbGradeNamesDoc=printDoc;
if(typeof window.nbStageWords==='function'){
  window.nbStageWords=(function(orig){ return function(doc){ var r=orig.apply(this,arguments); printDoc(doc); return r; }; })(window.nbStageWords);
} else window.nbStageWords=printDoc;
/* الشاشة */
var pending=[], sched=false;
function flush(){ sched=false; var l=pending; pending=[]; if(!C) return; l.forEach(function(n){ try{ if(n.isConnected!==false) walk(n); }catch(e){} }); }
function queue(n){ pending.push(n); if(!sched){ sched=true; (window.queueMicrotask||setTimeout)(flush); } }
try{
  new MutationObserver(function(ms){
    if(!C) return;
    ms.forEach(function(m){
      if(m.type==='characterData'){ if(C.seen.get(m.target)!==m.target.nodeValue) queue(m.target); }
      else m.addedNodes.forEach(function(n){ if(n.nodeType===3||n.nodeType===1) queue(n); });
    });
  }).observe(document.documentElement,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});
}catch(e){}
function refresh(){ build(); if(C) walk(document.body); }
window.nbGradeNamesRefresh=refresh;
if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',refresh); else refresh();
/* بعد المزامنة أو الاستيراد تتغير APP */
['saveApp','applyWifiPack','restoreBackupData'].forEach(function(k){
  if(typeof window[k]!=='function') return;
  window[k]=(function(orig){ return function(){ var r=orig.apply(this,arguments); try{ var before=JSON.stringify(C&&C.map||{}); build(); if(JSON.stringify(C&&C.map||{})!==before&&C) walk(document.body); }catch(e){} return r; }; })(window[k]);
});

/* نافذة تسمية الصفوف */
function visibleLabels(){ var l=[]; try{ l=gradebookGradeLabels(); }catch(e){} if(!l||!l.length){ try{ l=(APP.grades||[]).filter(function(g){ return (g.sections||[]).length; }).map(function(g){ return g.label; }); }catch(e){} } return l; }
window.nbOpenGradeNames=function(){
  var ov=document.getElementById('nbGnOverlay'); if(ov) ov.remove();
  ov=document.createElement('div'); ov.id='nbGnOverlay';
  ov.style.cssText='position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2147483000;background:rgba(0,0,0,.45);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px';
  var m=names(), L=visibleLabels();
  var rows=L.map(function(g,i){ return '<div class="nbgn-row"><div class="nbgn-old"><small>الاسم الأصلي</small><b>'+esc(g)+'</b></div><input type="text" maxlength="40" data-g="'+esc(g)+'" value="'+esc(m[g]||'')+'" placeholder="'+esc(g)+'"><button type="button" class="nbgn-x" title="إرجاع الاسم الأصلي" data-i="'+i+'">↺</button></div>'; }).join('');
  ov.innerHTML='<div class="nbgn-box" dir="rtl"><style>'+
    '.nbgn-box{background:var(--card-bg,#fff);color:inherit;width:min(560px,100%);max-height:88vh;overflow:auto;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.3);padding:18px}'+
    'html[data-ui-skin^="night"] .nbgn-box,body.theme-dark .nbgn-box{background:#18212b;color:#e8eef3}'+
    '.nbgn-box h3{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:19px}.nbgn-box p{margin:0 0 12px;opacity:.8;font-size:13px;line-height:1.8}'+
    '.nbgn-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px 1fr 42px;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:8px;border:1px solid rgba(127,127,127,.25);border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:7px}'+
    '.nbgn-old small{display:block;font-size:10.5px;opacity:.65}.nbgn-old b{font-size:14px}'+
    '.nbgn-row input{width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;border:1.5px solid rgba(127,127,127,.35);background:rgba(127,127,127,.06);color:inherit;font:700 15px inherit;font-family:inherit}'+
    '.nbgn-x{height:40px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid rgba(127,127,127,.35);background:transparent;color:inherit;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer}'+
    '.nbgn-act{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-start;margin-top:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}</style>'+
    '<h3>✏️ تسمية الصفوف</h3><p>اكتب الاسم الذي تريده لأي صف، ويظهر في كل البرنامج والطباعة. اترك الخانة فارغة لإبقاء الاسم الأصلي. البيانات والدرجات لا تتغير.</p>'+
    (rows||'<div style="padding:16px;opacity:.75">لا توجد صفوف مفعّلة.</div>')+
    '<div class="nbgn-act"><button type="button" class="material-btn" id="nbGnSave">💾 حفظ الأسماء</button><button type="button" class="material-btn secondary" id="nbGnCancel">إلغاء</button></div></div>';
  document.body.appendChild(ov);
  ov.addEventListener('click',function(e){ if(e.target===ov) ov.remove(); });
  ov.querySelector('#nbGnCancel').onclick=function(){ ov.remove(); };
  ov.querySelectorAll('.nbgn-x').forEach(function(b){ b.onclick=function(){ var inp=b.parentNode.querySelector('input'); inp.value=''; inp.focus(); }; });
  ov.querySelector('#nbGnSave').onclick=function(){
    var nm={}, used={};
    var inputs=[].slice.call(ov.querySelectorAll('input[data-g]')), bad='';
    inputs.forEach(function(inp){ var g=inp.getAttribute('data-g'), v=String(inp.value||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); if(v&&v!==g){ if(used[v]) bad=v; used[v]=1; nm[g]=v; } });
    if(bad){ alert('الاسم «'+bad+'» مكرر لأكثر من صف. اختر اسماً مختلفاً لكل صف.'); return; }
    /* الاحتفاظ بأسماء صفوف المراحل الأخرى */
    var old=names(); Object.keys(old).forEach(function(k){ if(inputs.every(function(i){ return i.getAttribute('data-g')!==k; })) nm[k]=old[k]; });
    APP.school.gradeNames=nm;
    try{ saveApp(); }catch(e){}
    ov.remove();
    build();
    /* إعادة رسم الواجهة الحالية حتى تعود النصوص لأصلها ثم تُطبَّق الأسماء الجديدة */
    try{ if(typeof renderGradesView==='function'&&document.getElementById('view-grades')&&getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('view-grades')).display!=='none') renderGradesView(false); }catch(e){}
    try{ if(typeof renderDashboard==='function') renderDashboard(); }catch(e){}
    if(C) walk(document.body);
    try{ if(typeof toast==='function') toast('✅ حُفظت أسماء الصفوف'); }catch(e){}
  };
};

  b.innerHTML='<span>✏️</span><div><strong>تسمية الصفوف</strong><small>غيّر اسم أي صف كما تريد، ويُعتمد في كل البرنامج والطباعة</small></div><b>›</b>';
  b.onclick=function(){ window.nbOpenGradeNames(); };
  tog.parentNode.insertBefore(b,tog.nextSibling);
}

/* =================== (2) رقم القيد في قسم التلاميذ =================== */
function findStudent(id){ var out=null; (APP.grades||[]).some(function(g){ return (g.sections||[]).some(function(s){ var st=(s.students||[]).find(function(x){ return x.id===id; }); if(st){ out={st:st,grade:g.label,sec:s}; return true; } return false; }); }); return out; }
/* قسم القيود: قيد مرتبط بالطالب يُضاف/يُحدَّث تلقائياً */
function syncRecord(st,noSave){
  try{
    if(typeof RECORDS_STATE==='undefined') return;
    if(!Array.isArray(RECORDS_STATE.items)) RECORDS_STATE.items=[];
    var no=String(st.registrationNo||'').trim();
    var it=RECORDS_STATE.items.find(function(r){ return r.studentId===st.id; });
    if(!no){ if(it&&it.autoFromStudent){ RECORDS_STATE.items.splice(RECORDS_STATE.items.indexOf(it),1); } else if(it){ it.recordNo=''; } }
    else if(it){ it.recordNo=no; it.name=String(st.name||'').trim()||it.name; }
    else{
      /* قيد موجود سابقاً بنفس الاسم وبلا رقم/بنفس الرقم: نربطه بدل التكرار */
      var nm=String(st.name||'').trim();
      var same=RECORDS_STATE.items.find(function(r){ return !r.studentId&&String(r.name||'').trim()===nm&&(!r.recordNo||String(r.recordNo)===no); });
      if(same){ same.studentId=st.id; same.recordNo=no; }
      else RECORDS_STATE.items.push({id:'rec_st_'+st.id,studentId:st.id,autoFromStudent:true,name:nm,recordNo:no,documentImage:'',grades:{},createdAt:new Date().toISOString()});
    }
    if(noSave) return;
    try{ if(typeof rebuildRecordLetterSeq==='function') rebuildRecordLetterSeq(); }catch(e){}
    if(typeof saveRecordsState==='function') saveRecordsState();
  }catch(e){ try{console.warn('nb-reg-sync',e);}catch(_){} }
}
window.nbSyncStudentRecord=syncRecord;
/* مطابقة دورية خفيفة: أي رقم قيد أُدخل من مكان آخر (السجل الوسطي، المزامنة، الاستيراد) يصل لقسم القيود */
function reconcile(){
  try{
    if(typeof RECORDS_STATE==='undefined') return;
    if(!Array.isArray(RECORDS_STATE.items)) RECORDS_STATE.items=[];
    var byId={}, changed=false;
    RECORDS_STATE.items.forEach(function(r){ if(r.studentId) byId[r.studentId]=r; });
    var alive={};
    (APP.grades||[]).forEach(function(g){ (g.sections||[]).forEach(function(s){ (s.students||[]).forEach(function(st){
      alive[st.id]=1; var no=String(st.registrationNo||'').trim(), it=byId[st.id];      if(no&&(!it||String(it.recordNo||'')!==no||(it.autoFromStudent&&String(it.name||'')!==String(st.name||'').trim()))){ syncRecord(st,true); changed=true; }
      else if(!no&&it&&it.autoFromStudent){ syncRecord(st,true); changed=true; }
    }); }); });
    for(var i=RECORDS_STATE.items.length-1;i>=0;i--){ var r=RECORDS_STATE.items[i]; if(r.autoFromStudent&&r.studentId&&!alive[r.studentId]){ RECORDS_STATE.items.splice(i,1); changed=true; } }
    if(changed){ try{ if(typeof rebuildRecordLetterSeq==='function') rebuildRecordLetterSeq(); }catch(e){} if(typeof saveRecordsState==='function') saveRecordsState(); }
  }catch(e){ try{console.warn('nb-reg-rec',e);}catch(_){} }
}
var recT=null; function reconcileSoon(){ clearTimeout(recT); recT=setTimeout(reconcile,1500); }
setTimeout(reconcile,3000);
if(typeof window.saveApp==='function'){ window.saveApp=(function(orig){ return function(){ var r=orig.apply(this,arguments); reconcileSoon(); return r; }; })(window.saveApp); }
window.nbSetStudentReg=function(inp){
  var f=findStudent(inp.getAttribute('data-st')); if(!f) return;
  var v=west(String(inp.value||'').trim()).replace(/\s+/g,'');
  var prev=String(f.st.registrationNo||'');
  if(v===prev) return;
  if(v){
    var dup=null; (APP.grades||[]).some(function(g){ return (g.sections||[]).some(function(s){ return (s.students||[]).some(function(x){ if(x.id!==f.st.id&&String(x.registrationNo||'')===v){ dup=x; return true; } return false; }); }); });
    if(dup&&!confirm('رقم القيد '+ar(v)+' مسجّل للطالب «'+dup.name+'». هل تريد حفظه لهذا الطالب أيضاً؟')){ inp.value=prev?ar(prev):''; return; }
  }
  f.st.registrationNo=v;
  try{ saveApp(); }catch(e){}
  syncRecord(f.st);
  inp.value=v?ar(v):'';
  inp.classList.add('st-reg-saved'); setTimeout(function(){ inp.classList.remove('st-reg-saved'); },900);
};
/* عند تعديل اسم الطالب: يتحدث اسم القيد المرتبط */
if(typeof window.saveStudentEdit==='function'){
  window.saveStudentEdit=(function(orig){ return function(){
    var id=typeof editingStudentId!=='undefined'?editingStudentId:null, regInp=document.getElementById('editStudentReg'), regVal=regInp?west(String(regInp.value||'').trim()).replace(/\s+/g,''):null;
    var r=orig.apply(this,arguments);
    try{ var f=id&&findStudent(id); if(f){ if(regVal!==null&&regVal!==String(f.st.registrationNo||'')){ f.st.registrationNo=regVal; try{ saveApp(); }catch(e){} try{ if(typeof renderStudentRows==='function') renderStudentRows(); }catch(e){} } if(f.st.registrationNo||RECORDS_STATE.items.some(function(x){ return x.studentId===id; })) syncRecord(f.st); } }catch(e){}
    return r; }; })(window.saveStudentEdit);
}
/* نافذة تعديل الطالب: خانة رقم القيد */

    return r; }; })(window.openStudentEdit);
}
/* بطاقات وقوائم الامتحان: رقم القيد الحقيقي للطالب إن وُجد */
if(typeof window.ensureExamStudentMeta==='function'){

}
/* الطباعة وتصدير إكسل لقائمة الطلاب: الخانة تظهر كنص */
function inputsToText(root){ try{ root.querySelectorAll('input.st-reg-input').forEach(function(i){ i.replaceWith(document.createTextNode(i.value||'')); }); }catch(e){} }
window.nbStudentsTableClone=inputsToText;

(document.head||document.documentElement).appendChild(CSS);
})();
</script>

<script>
/* ===== nb-v1.44: قسم «المواد والمراحل» =====
   تبويبان: (1) المواد — كما كانت تماماً. (2) الصفوف والشعب — تفعيل الصفوف، إضافة الشعب وحذفها، وتسمية الصفوف.
   إعداد الصفوف والشعب انتقل من قسم التلاميذ/الطلاب إلى هنا (يبقى في شاشة الإعداد الأولى للمدرسة الجديدة كما هو).
   يستعمل نفس دوال البرنامج (toggleGrade / addSection / removeSection / saveApp) فلا يتغير شكل البيانات. */
(function(){
'use strict';
function esc(v){ return typeof escapeHtml==='function'?escapeHtml(String(v==null?'':v)):String(v==null?'':v); }
var TAB='subjects';
try{ TAB=sessionStorage.getItem('nbSubjTab')||'subjects'; }catch(e){}
function setTab(t){ TAB=t; try{ sessionStorage.setItem('nbSubjTab',t); }catch(e){} }
function isPro(){ try{ return currentStage()==='professional'; }catch(e){ return false; } }
function names(){ var m=APP&&APP.school&&APP.school.gradeNames; return (m&&typeof m==='object')?m:{}; }

var CSS='#view-subjects .nbsp-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:4px 0 12px}'+
 '#view-subjects .nbsp-head .mi{font-size:26px;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1b5e20,#43a047);color:#fff;flex:0 0 auto}'+
 '#view-subjects .nbsp-head h2{margin:0;font-size:22px}#view-subjects .nbsp-head p{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:13px;opacity:.75}'+

 '#view-subjects .nbsp-tab.on{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0d2b5c,#16488f);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(13,43,92,.25)}'+
 '#nbStagesTab .nbst-intro{margin:0 0 12px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(22,72,143,.10);border:1px solid rgba(22,72,143,.35);font-size:13px;line-height:1.9;font-weight:700}'+
 '#nbStagesTab .nbst-group{margin:0 0 16px}#nbStagesTab .nbst-group>h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:17px}'+
 '#nbStagesTab .nbst-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:10px}'+
 '#nbStagesTab .nbst-card{border:1.5px solid rgba(127,127,127,.28);border-radius:16px;padding:12px;background:rgba(127,127,127,.04);transition:.15s}'+
 '#nbStagesTab .nbst-card.on{border-color:rgba(46,125,50,.65);background:rgba(46,125,50,.06)}'+
 '#nbStagesTab .nbst-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}'+
 '#nbStagesTab .nbst-sw{position:relative;width:46px;height:26px;flex:0 0 auto}#nbStagesTab .nbst-sw input{opacity:0;width:0;height:0}'+
 '#nbStagesTab .nbst-sw span{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(127,127,127,.45);cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}'+
 '#nbStagesTab .nbst-sw span:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:20px;height:20px;top:3px;right:3px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;transition:.2s;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}'+
 '#nbStagesTab .nbst-sw input:checked+span{background:#2e7d32}#nbStagesTab .nbst-sw input:checked+span:before{transform:translateX(-20px)}'+
 '#nbStagesTab .nbst-title{flex:1;min-width:0}#nbStagesTab .nbst-title b{display:block;font-size:16px}#nbStagesTab .nbst-title small{opacity:.65;font-size:11.5px}'+
 '#nbStagesTab .nbst-body{margin-top:10px;display:none}#nbStagesTab .nbst-card.on .nbst-body{display:block}'+

 '#nbStagesTab .nbst-name label{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap;opacity:.8}'+
